newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Microwave agrees to settle suits.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Microwave agrees to settle suits.

text.p: Cincinnati Microwave Inc said on Monday that it reached an agreement in principle to settle four securities class action lawsuits for $9.25 million in cash and shares.
The four consolidated lawsuits were filed against the company in October and November 1995. The agreement is subject to court approval and other contingencies, it said.
Cincinnati Microwave said it continues to deny all "material allegations" contained in the complaint, but decided to settle the lawsuit to avoid the expense of further legal proceedings.
The exact nature of the lawsuits was not disclosed.
Cincinnati Microwave designs, manufactures and markets ultra-high frequency and microwave wireless communications products.
